speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant). The combination of a 6-month history of disinhibition, loss of social norms, dietary changes leading to weight gain, apathy, and blunted affect in a 55-year-old male is highly characteristic of FTD, often caused by underlying tau or TDP-43 proteinopathies.
